title_sq: Shitet zyre ne zonen e Ish-Bllokut
description_sq:
Disponojme zyre per shitje ne zonen me elitare te Tiranes, ne Bllok.
Prona ndodhet ne katin e dyte te nje pallati buze rruge, te mire administruar dhe me ashensor; Eshte e mobiluar me cdo pajisje qe e ben zyren funksionale dhe jepet me qira si e tille me cmimin e publikuar.
Blerje e kesaj prone eshte nje ivestim shume i mire, pasi vendndodhja e ben ate shume te aksesueshme dhe me interes per t'u perdorur per zyra te bizneseve te ndryshme si: Klinika dentare, qender estetike, klinike mjekesore, noteri, zyre avokatie, agjenci marketingu etj.
Prona eshte e perbere nga nje holl i madh ne hyrje, tre ambjente pune, dy tualete dhe nje verande.
Per me shume detaje, ju lutem na kontaktoni.
title_en: Office for sale in the Ish-Bllok area
description_en: We have an office for sale in the most elite area of ​​Tirana, in Block. The property is located on the second floor of a street-side building, well managed and with an elevator; It is furnished with every device that makes the office functional and is rented as such at the published price. Buying this property is a very good investment, as the location makes it very accessible and interesting to be used for offices of various businesses such as: dental clinic, aesthetic center, medical clinic, notary, law office, marketing agency, etc. The property consists of a large entrance hall, three work areas, two toilets and a veranda. For more details, please contact us.
